_about: GTA VI artwork style presets for Qwen-Image 2.1. Every option was written by studying Rockstar's official GTA VI artwork wallpapers (rockstargames.com/VI/media). Style options describe traits of the artwork only; locations borrow scene ideas from the screenshots and postcards. 'ref' describes the official artwork each option was taken from. Edit or add options freely: the nodes read this file at ComfyUI start. Text fragments follow Qwen's PE-I2I prompt spec: affirmative phrasing only, no 'no X'. Tokens: {fig} = the figure / the figures, {pos} = her / his / their, {text} = the sign text.

style_variant.name: Key art (default)
style_variant.medium: a stylised 2D digital illustration in the look of modern crime-game key art and animated film keyframes, with crisp detailed figures set against a flatter, simplified background
style_variant.line_art: thin, slightly uneven dark brown-black ink lines that are heavier on the outer silhouette and fine inside, tracing contours, clothing seams and folds
style_variant.shading: cel shading in two to three hard-edged tone steps and flat graphic shadow shapes tinted cool violet-blue
style_variant.detail: hair drawn as chunky clumped locks picked out with fine ink strands, and faces with mature, realistic adult proportions and defined angular planes at the cheekbones, brows and jaw

style_variant.name: Character loading screen (gritty)
style_variant.ref: character art (boatyard veteran), character art (man on a boat), character art (man in a linen suit)
style_variant.medium: a stylised 2D digital character portrait in the look of open-world crime-game loading-screen art, with crisp detailed figures dominating the frame against a flatter, simplified background
style_variant.line_art: thin dark ink contour lines plus delicate hatched pen strokes that pick out hair strands, stubble, arm hair, wrinkles and fabric texture
style_variant.shading: cel shading in two to three hard-edged tone steps and flat graphic shadow shapes tinted cool violet-blue
style_variant.detail: weathered skin with wrinkles, pores and hair drawn in fine hatching, sun-faded fabric and visible tattoo linework

style_variant.name: Glam (cover art)
style_variant.medium: a stylised 2D digital illustration in the look of one panel from a crime-game cover art grid, dense with detail and punchy colour, cropped tightly around the action
style_variant.line_art: thin, slightly uneven dark brown-black ink lines that are heavier on the outer silhouette and fine inside, tracing contours, clothing seams and folds
style_variant.shading: bold two-tone graphic shading with crisp, angular shadow shapes tinted deep violet
style_variant.detail: glossy lips, sculpted eyebrows, long lashes and bright specular highlights on skin, nails and jewellery

style_variant.name: Sketchy ink
style_variant.medium: a stylised 2D digital illustration in the look of modern crime-game key art and animated film keyframes, with crisp detailed figures set against a flatter, simplified background
style_variant.line_art: loose, sketchy pencil-and-ink linework with slightly broken contour lines and quick hatched strokes left visible in the shadows
style_variant.shading: hard-edged cel shadow shapes combined with soft airbrushed gradients across skin and sky, shadows tinted lilac and blue
style_variant.detail: hair drawn as chunky clumped locks picked out with fine ink strands, and faces with mature, realistic adult proportions and defined angular planes at the cheekbones, brows and jaw

style_variant.name: Synthwave album (flat)
style_variant.medium: a stylised 2D digital poster illustration in the look of a retro synthwave album cover, with soft glowing colour and a dreamy, nostalgic mood
style_variant.line_art: very sparse, soft ink lines only on key contours, letting painted colour shapes define most of the forms
style_variant.shading: posterised flat colour areas with gentle gradients and shadows washed in a single lavender tone
style_variant.detail: simplified faces and hands built from a few clean graphic shapes with minimal interior detail
